## Independent exact-head review: BLOCKED

Reviewed head `ce518e067ebef00335779e5fa9126e269f664b67`, tree `e2c14b6c8765752d77c28965d14af1b0eb9e6e25`, against base `0528b9e5ec31c0f4cfeb383c99859f15f51ea920`. The live head/tree were re-fetched before this verdict and remained unchanged.

### Blocking finding: claimed 125-test matrix is reproducibly red

The prescribed producer suite fails deterministically at `scripts/vlm/__tests__/issue_1766_future_semantic_kg_producer.test.py:1401`:

```text
Command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=scripts/vlm \
  python3 scripts/vlm/__tests__/issue_1766_future_semantic_kg_producer.test.py \
  FutureSemanticKgProducerTests.test_producer_runtime_implementations_remain_independent

AssertionError at line 1401:
all changed artifact paths must start with
artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/p4-semantic-kg/
```

The exact offenders are the three files added by this PR under the new shared authority root:

- `artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/shared-authority/structural-global.json`
- `artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/shared-authority/canonical-semantic-object-library.json`
- `artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/shared-authority/shared-authority-descriptor.json`

This reproduced both in the complete prescribed chain and as the isolated single test from a clean detached exact-head checkout. It is not an environment or command artifact. The deterministic reconciliation check itself passed (`active_terminal_rollback_replay=PASS_via_#1767_harness`, `deterministic_rebuild=PASS`), and the runtime validator is unchanged; the defect is that the inherited implementation-independence gate was not made successor-aware for the new, contract-required shared outputs. Consequently the PR's `125 / 125 passed` claim is false on the reviewed tree, and the terminal hard-gate claim is not fully verified.

Please narrowly update the inherited test to admit only the three intended shared-authority outputs while preserving its runtime-validator immutability and producer/runtime code-independence assertions. Then rerun the complete 125-test matrix and request a fresh exact-head review.

Per the AO stop boundary, mandatory pixel review was not continued after this substantive gate failure. This BLOCKED verdict is review evidence only; it is not merge or successor authorization.
